name: CBS Bahamas (Commonwealth Building Supplies)
brand_truth: A Bahamian-owned store on Carmichael Road that has built Nassau since 1973 and now sends every order to the mailboat for free.
buyer: Nassau homeowners and renovators, contractors buying in quantity, and Family Island homeowners ordering by phone for mailboat delivery.

design.signature: Shop the house: interactive line-drawn Bahamian house elevation with 10 hotspots mapped to CBS departments; mailboat planner chart with route draw and personalised 5-step guide; louvred shutters opening on the hours card

current_site_findings: The homepage opens on a seasonal product feed; the 1973 Bahamian-owned story is not on it.
Free mailboat delivery, the strongest Family Island promise, lives in a 2024 blog post.
Directories show a second main number (242-325-2505) and an old wixsite contact page with different hours.
Store email vs online-orders email is never explained in one place.
pitch_line: Your online store works, but your best promise, free mailboat drop-off to every island, is buried in a blog post; this front door puts it, your hours and your 1973 story on the first screen and hands buyers straight into your shop.
assumptions: cbs@cbsbahamas.com is the right inbox for stock and bulk questions
Department summaries are short category descriptions built from the store's own category names and products seen online
notes: Record said DOMAIN LOST; re-checked 2026-11-05: cbsbahamas.com (with and without www) serves CBS's own live Evolution X e-commerce store. Built as a Track A brand front door that links into their existing shop, not a store replacement. Pitch is weaker than a no-website prospect; consider repricing as a landing/brand layer. No store photography used (banners have baked-in text); ask owner for store, warehouse and team photos. Map and island chart are illustrations. No WhatsApp found.
